title: Convince Nikulas to stay in Skaal Village
description: Edla asks the player to convince her son Nikulas to remain in Skaal Village instead of leaving to seek adventure in the wider world.

base_facts: My son Nikulas wants to leave the village and see the world beyond our lands.
I wish Nikulas would stay in Skaal Village with his family.
The Skaal live simple but meaningful lives.

TALK_TO_EDLA: An outsider has agreed to speak with Nikulas about staying.
RETURN_TO_EDLA: Nikulas has agreed to stay in the village. Calls the outsider a true friend of the Skaal and blesses them in the All-Maker's name.
Rewarded the outsider with five Ashen Grass Pod, five Emperor Parasol Moss, and five Scathecraw, herbs unique to Solstheim's lands.
Feels the joy in her heart at Nikulas staying far outweighs any reward she could give.
Her disposition toward the player has increased for reuniting her family.

base_facts: I want to go out into the world and earn great glory.
I want to hunt the deadliest creatures and claim vast riches.
I am weary of farming, fishing, and hunting deer in Skaal Village.

CONVINCE_NIKULAS: I have been reminded of my duties as a son and as a Skaal. I will stay in the village.
RETURN_TO_EDLA: Has chosen to remain in Skaal Village, accepting his duties as a son and as a Skaal over his eagerness for adventure.
Thanked the outsider for their wisdom in reminding him what truly matters.

beats.comment: Player speaks with Edla about her son and agrees to help convince him to stay.

triggers.intent: Player explicitly agrees to help Edla by convincing Nikulas to stay in the village.
examples_yes: I'll talk to him for you.
I can help with your son.
examples_no: Tell me more about him first.

beats.comment: Player convinces Nikulas to stay in Skaal Village by reminding him of his duties and his mother.
Player returns to Edla and reports that Nikulas will stay. She rewards the player with herbs.
